requirements.title: Igbo-Language Video Performance
requirements.definition: Produce one video with correct and intelligible spoken Igbo performance.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the language and pronunciation quality of the commissioned video; literal script adherence, opening staging, and delivery deadlines are separate concerns.

requirements.title: Exact Spoken Script Adherence
requirements.definition: Deliver all required spoken content in the supplied order and exactly as written, without additions, omissions, or substitutions.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers textual completeness and fidelity; pronunciation quality, phone-based staging, and visible gameplay actions can be assessed independently.

requirements.title: Phone-Message Opening Staging
requirements.definition: Begin the video by stating that a person sent a message and audibly reading that message from the phone used for the game demonstration.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the opening action, placement, and phone continuity; the exact message wording belongs to script adherence and its pronunciation belongs to Igbo-language performance.

requirements.title: Video Duration Constraint
requirements.definition: Keep the completed video within a 50-to-60-second duration.
requirements.boundary_note: Duration is independently measurable, but it appears only in a freelancer feasibility statement and is not directly confirmed by the client in the supplied messages.

requirements.title: Gameplay Demonstration Sequence
requirements.definition: Show the scripted progression from the fake game version and immediate loss to the real app, wager, win, withdrawal, confirmation, and banking notification.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers visible demonstration actions and their sequence rather than the exact wording of the narration or the phone-message opening.

unresolved_candidates.description: The freelancer reports that exact Igbo rendering of the full script exceeds a 50-to-60-second duration, but the supplied history does not show a client decision resolving the apparent duration-versus-script conflict.
The freelancer conditionally offers a high-resolution, watermark-free final version, but no supplied client message clearly establishes or accepts this as an independent delivery-format Requirement.
